text: Spread a clean cloth on the puja peeta and place the picture or idol of Dhanvantari Swamy on it.
If you don't have one, you can use a picture of Sri Mahavishnu.
If you have neither, open the picture of Dhanvantari Swamy in Pocket Panchangam and meditate on him.
Place a turmeric Ganapati or a Ganapati idol beside it, and get the puja items ready.
